chunks: Muḥammad ibn Qays narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
Regarding a man who killed his mother, he said: “If it was by mistake, then he has a share in her inheritance; but if he killed her intentionally, then he inherits nothing from her.”
ai.seo_question: Does a son inherit from his mother if he killed her accidentally or intentionally?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance in the case of matricide. If the killing was accidental, the son still receives his share of inheritance, but if he killed his mother deliberately, he is barred from inheriting from her.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5245 - Muhammad ibn Qays narrated from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that he said regarding a man who killed his mother:
"If he killed her accidentally, he is entitled to a share of her inheritance. However, if he killed her intentionally, he does not inherit anything from her."
